title: Electric Service by Rate Schedule: Connection, Transfer, Same-Day and Rate Change Terms
content:
**New service desk terms.** The figures below apply when an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is opened, transferred, connected the same day, or moved to another schedule at the member's request.

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service connection fee, new or returning member at a location | $35.00 | $35.00 | $35.00 | $50.00 | $75.00 | $75.00 | $150.00 |
| Transfer fee, energized location into a different member's name without a field visit | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 |
| Additional same-day connect fee | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $100.00 |
| Full calendar months a schedule stays in effect before a member-requested change | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Summary by schedule group

| Schedules | Connection fee | Transfer fee | Same-day fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| R, RS, FH | $35.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 |
| GS-1 | $50.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 |
| GS-3, IR | $75.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 |
| LP | $150.00 | $50.00 | $100.00 |

The rate change waiting period is 12 full calendar months on all seven schedules.

### Hypothetical example

A returning member opening a Schedule GS-1 shop account with a same-day connect (hypothetical) is billed the $50.00 connection fee and the $50.00 same-day fee, $100.00 in all.
